  "categories": [

      "name": "p2p",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Carries the P2P label and modifies connection polling in src/net.cpp and src/netbase.cpp.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.65,
      "reason_tag": "DoS protection",
      "rationale": "Restricts select() exception monitoring to connection establishment, preventing established P2P connections from entering an unprogressing busy-spin loop when receiving TCP urgent data that Bitcoin Core does not consume."
    },
    {
      "name": "rpc",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Modifies src/httpserver.cpp and src/httpserver.h to disconnect sockets immediately on POLLERR or POLLHUP when reads are paused.",
      "band": "P4",
      "score": 0.20,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Adjusts HTTP server socket handling so that connections in backpressure immediately disconnect on poll errors instead of attempting doomed sends, a minor robustness fix for the HTTP daemon."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches test/functional/test_framework/netutil.py only to support the targeted p2p and http socket error tests.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "test coverage",
      "rationale": "The functional test framework additions solely support testing P2P and HTTP socket error behavior rather than providing general test infrastructure capabilities."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Modifies the socket abstraction primitives in src/util/sock.h and src/util/sock.cpp.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.45,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Adds ConnErrorEventFlag to Sock::Wait() so socket callers opt into exception monitoring only during non-blocking connects, correcting the utility primitive's select() behavior across platforms."
    }
